title: Metadata kind TextTrack behavior is inconsistent on browsers

labels.name: interop
labels.description: Implementations are not interoperable with each other

body:
The behavior of [TextTracks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#texttrack) of kind `metadata` is not specified for [cues](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#texttrackcue) at startTime `0` and startTime at the duration of the content.

Expected behavior:

- `cuechange` event occurs only after playback starts for a cue with `startTime: 0`
- `cuechange` event occurs with the `ended` event for a cue with startTime set as the duration. e.g if a video is 5 seconds long and a cue with `startTime: 5` is present, when currentTime is 5 the `cuechange` event is observed then the `ended` event is observed.

Adding a specification for this TextTrack kind would bring metadata TextTracks closer in behavior to other TextTrack kinds, allowing video players to make use of them in the browser.

Observed behavior:

- Some browsers fire the `cuechange` event before the video plays for cues with `startTime: 0`
- Some browsers do not fire the `cuechange` event at all for cues with `startTime: 0`
- Some browsers do not fire the `cuechange` event at all for cues at the duration
- Even in the same browser, cues at the duration fire at inconsistent times

Example: https://plnkr.co/edit/mMLqmdLRHVe7TZNQVrpK?p=preview
